lines:
The only remaining path to task 129's acceptance bar (uncached input within ~1.5x of DSH). Everything attributable to prompt caching is fixed and verified; what is left is the size of what Aworkit appends each turn.

Measured on test1_3 (chat.ef71761303be6ac41947a5a7954783d4ade0b614, 65 turns, uncached 64,192) against the DSH run of the same prompt (session-e521226b, 79 steps, uncached 36,540):
- cold starts removed, Aworkit re-bills 52,740 uncached tokens over 63 turns = 837/turn; DSH re-bills 22,000 over 78 steps = 282/turn. Ratio ~3x, and it is the whole remaining gap.
- Aworkit's per-turn uncached cost is the new material itself: the 7 turns above 2,000 (49% of its uncached total) each append 7-25 KB of new content (a file write result, a shell/job output, an image read), and its median turn still re-bills 532 tokens where DSH's is ~212.
- DSH's tool results are tiny by comparison: median 572 bytes, max 7,138 bytes over its 79 results.

Levers to evaluate, cheapest first (do not reduce what the model is shown merely to move the number; each option must keep the information recoverable, e.g. a bounded capture plus a pointer the model can re-read):
1. Bound individual tool results at settle, with an explicit "truncated; re-read with offset/limit" pointer. Aworkit already pages file reads (commit 6869449) and has a lossless compression path that fired twice in test1_qwen (grep 1,265 -> 704 tokens, job.list 1,366 -> 728) while skipping 58 candidates for failing the size/savings gates - see the compression-gates task.
2. Re-check what the shell and job tools return: whole stdout plus a cursor, versus DSH's small tail.
3. Re-check image reads: one image costs 200-968 prompt tokens by dimensions and is replayed every later turn; the bounded image dispatch already caps attachments at 16 images / 24 MiB, so the remaining question is whether a screenshot must stay in the replayed history at all.
4. Consider whether the assistant's own message content (reasoning is now replayed, ~64.5k tokens on one test1_2 turn) should be replayed in full or summarised on later turns - currently it is retained verbatim by design.

Acceptance: a repeat benchmark run with total tokens no worse than test1_3's 7.46M and uncached input within ~1.5x of DSH's 36,540, with no conformance regression on tetris-conformance.js (currently 9/9).

data.title: Cut per-turn novel tool-result payload (837 vs DSH's 282 uncached tokens per turn)
